name: Arden University (London Stratford and Manchester campuses)

facts.text: Arden University began in 1990 as an online delivery partner for traditional universities (Resource Development International, RDI), earned taught-degree awarding powers in 2014 and became Arden University in 2015; its head office is Arden House, Middlemarch Park, Coventry, CV3 4FJ.

Arden describes itself as having 'more than 40,000 ambitious students learning with us online and at our UK campuses', '90+ degree courses' and nine campus locations across London, Birmingham, Manchester, Leeds, Newcastle, Nottingham and Berlin; it is not a traditional campus university.

International students studying full-time on campus with a Student visa are taught at two UK campuses only: Manchester and London (Stratford). Birmingham, Leeds, Newcastle and Nottingham are not offered to international on-campus students.
facts.sourceTitle: UK campuses for international students | Arden University

facts.text: The London campus is the Turing Building, 3 Westfield Avenue, Stratford Cross, London E20 1HZ (borough of Newham), a 1-2 minute walk from Stratford Station (Central and Jubilee lines, DLR, Overground, National Rail), next to Westfield Stratford City and Queen Elizabeth Olympic Park; it spans the ground to the 6th floor.
facts.sourceTitle: Study in Stratford | International | Arden University

facts.text: The Stratford Cross campus was announced on 27 May 2025 as Arden's new London campus opening that September; Arden's older London sites are Ealing (Santon House, 53-55 Uxbridge Road, W5 5SA) and Holborn (Buchanan House, 30 Holborn, EC1N 2LX).

The Manchester campus is at 2 Hardman Street, Manchester, M3 3HF, in the Spinningfields financial district, over two floors, with an 'Oasis Room' for quiet reflection or prayer; Arden markets Manchester on its lower cost of living than other UK cities.
facts.sourceTitle: Study at Arden's Manchester Campus, UK | International

facts.text: Arden 'does not offer on-campus accommodation'. Accommodation Officers help students find private or third-party student housing; London students are told to register on 'Arden Student Pad' for properties around Stratford, Manchester students to look near the city centre.

Standard international fees are £16,000 for an undergraduate top-up and £17,500 for a postgraduate course. A portion of the fee is paid as a deposit on accepting the offer, the value stated during the application; the balance is paid in full or in instalments before enrolment.
facts.sourceTitle: Fees for International students | Arden University

facts.text: With the Arden UK Welcome Offer (up to £5,000 off, intakes to September 2026) fees are £13,000 London / £12,000 Manchester for undergraduate and £13,500 London / £12,500 Manchester for postgraduate; for the November 2026, February 2027 and May 2027 intakes the offer is up to £4,500 (UG £13,500 / £12,500, PG £14,000 / £13,000).
facts.sourceTitle: Scholarships and funding | International | Arden University

facts.text: A 'Super Early Bird' offer takes a further £3,000 off the programme fee for international students who hold an unconditional offer and have paid the deposit by the deadline (29 October 2026 for November 2026, 25 January 2027 for February 2027, 12 April 2027 for May 2027); it can be combined with other offers.
facts.sourceTitle: Scholarships and funding | International | Arden University

facts.text: Arden's own visa page tells Student visa holders 'they are unable to work while sponsored by Arden University' and 'no work is permitted on their Student visa'; there is no recourse to public funds, attendance at all study sessions is required, and leaving before the end of the course may lead to the visa being curtailed.
facts.sourceTitle: Your Responsibilities as a Visa Holder | International | Arden

facts.text: Arden lists '20+ accreditations, memberships and professional bodies' including BPS, AACSB, ACCA, CIMA, CMI, APM, CIPD and ILM, and was named Higher Education Institution of the Year at the EducationInvestor Awards 2023.
Arden's international page says 'Join over 7,000 international students already studying with Arden' and claims 'Top 5 in the UK for Student Experience (NSS 2025)'.
facts.sourceTitle: Study full-time, on campus in the UK | Arden University

facts.text: Arden's compliance contact for Student visa matters is the Compliance Adviser at immigration@arden.ac.uk; a CAS is issued by Arden only after the application is complete, and the visa application cannot start until the CAS is received.

sources.notes: Fetched 11 September 2026. Arden's own page, two sections headed 'Intention to Study' and 'Financial', with the example questions quoted verbatim above. Framing: 'As part of the Student visa process, the Home Office/UKVI will assess whether a student is genuine before granting student leave.' 'The interview selection process is random, so being called for an interview does not mean there is anything wrong with your application.' 'It is crucial to answer honestly - do not provide responses based on what you think the interviewer wants to hear.' The page does not say who conducts the interview, how long it lasts or whether it is recorded. Distinctive to Arden: several questions on whether the financial documents are original and whether the Home Office could ring the bank to verify them, whether the fee can be paid in one amount, and whether the student has read the refund policy.

sources.notes: Fetched 11 September 2026 (raw HTML read). Verbatim: 'To advise Arden students that they are unable to work while sponsored by Arden University', 'To understand no work is permitted on their Student visa', 'To ensure you attend all study sessions', 'To advise students that they are unable to claim public funds', 'leaving before the end of your course, may result in your visa being curtailed (cut short)'. This is the correct answer to any question about part-time work at Arden: none is permitted.

sources.title: Arden University: live CAS Shield tenant (arden.cas-shield.com)
sources.notes: Probed 11 September 2026: the subdomain answers HTTP 200 with the Enroly CAS Shield sign-in page, byte-identical (4,009 bytes) to chester.cas-shield.com, while random subdomains answer nothing, so Arden runs its CAS process through Enroly. CAS Shield interviews follow the themes in Brunel's published policy; Arden's own pages describe only the Home Office credibility interview and do not say whether a recorded CAS Shield interview is switched on for every Nepali applicant.
